name: memory-pulse
description: Causal project memory that costs ~670 tokens of tool definitions, not your context window. Corrections surface first and are enforced: a PreToolUse guard blocks an edit that writes a withdrawn value back and cites the ledger line that retired it. The ledger is a local file you own.

interface.shortDescription: Project memory whose corrections surface first — and are enforced.
interface.longDescription: Re-enter a project through its causal ledger at session start, recall what caused what, record decisions and corrections with withdrawn terms, and let the guard block any edit that reintroduces a withdrawn value. Reads cost ~670 tokens of tool definitions; the ledger is a local file in your repo and writes work offline.
defaultPrompt: Pulse this project's memory before we start.
Record a correction: the price was $49, it is now $29.
What caused the last outage according to the ledger?
